about: Small recording files that every way into the import refuses: the command line, the import route and the Runs screen. Each is refused with the one reason given here, the same through every door.

files.duplicate-key.json: The file is not UTF-8 JSON: the key 'title' appears twice in one object
files.nan-number.json: The file is not UTF-8 JSON: NaN is not a JSON number
files.byte-order-mark.json: The file is not UTF-8 JSON: Unexpected UTF-8 BOM (decode using utf-8-sig): line 1 column 1 (char 0)
files.not-json.json: The file is not UTF-8 JSON: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes: line 1 column 3 (char 2)
files.trailing-member.json: The file is not UTF-8 JSON: Extra data: line 153 column 2 (char 2972)
files.not-utf8.json: The file is not UTF-8 JSON: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xff in position 90: invalid start byte
files.title-null.json: recording.title is null; it must be given.
files.field-number-as-float.json: events[0].fields must hold at most 64 plain values: text of at most 300 characters, a number no further than 9007199254740992 from zero, true, false or null.
files.alert-on-another-host.json: alerts[0].host is not the host of the events the alert matched.
